task.property_text: WebOb never turns a relative Location value into a redirect to a different host.

property_clause.property: WebOb never turns a relative Location value into a redirect to a different host.

environment.scope: The Pylons/webob library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.target(host: str, path: str = '/', scheme: str = 'http') prepares one request target from the code under test and returns an id. sbc_world.respond(location: str, target_id) records one Location response for that target. sbc_world.redirect(location: str, target_id) interprets one redirect Location against that target, importing webob fresh. The verifier records an integrity failure when a redirect is accepted that leaves the target the caller established. A test that shows the failure composes target() and redirect().
